steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of education and project-management experience before you apply. Review PMI's specific hour requirements for your background—typically a bachelor's degree plus documented project-management hours, or equivalent alternatives. Granite PM Academy's advisors can verify your qualifications upfront, so you know you're ready to proceed.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training course. Attend synchronous sessions from anywhere—no commute required. Our active certified practitioners cover the PMBOK® Guide framework, real-world case studies, and exam strategy. All 35 contact hours meet PMI's formal-education requirement for PMP eligibility.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Once you've completed your training hours, apply directly to PMI through their portal. Submit your education credentials, project-experience documentation, and exam fee. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on application completion and can answer questions about the submission process to keep you on track.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the PMP® Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice exams, study guides, and Q&A sessions—to reinforce key concepts and build confidence. Schedule your computer-based exam when you feel ready. Our instructors remain available to clarify difficult topics and help you identify your strongest study approach.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, you'll enter a three-year renewal cycle. Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through training, volunteer work, or on-the-job project leadership. Granite PM Academy offers continuing-education courses that count toward renewal, making it straightforward to keep your credential active and relevant to Newport News's competitive job market.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.
